subject: Pilot connectivity handshake + milestone agreement
messages:
From: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@clearvista.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@clearvista.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot collaboration — high level asks and timeline

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at ClearVista is excited by Redwood's latency profile and the routing/fallback story. Before we move to a short pilot (2–3 week eval), we need a simple mutual plan that captures who does what for environment readiness: org onboarding, API keys, IP allowlist, and the VPC peering window.

High level we need:
- A single test org with role-based accounts for our infra team.
- Scoped API keys for the trial (non-production).
- IP ranges to be allowlisted and expected egress behavior.
- VPC peering support on your side (we run in us-west-2).

Target timeline: pilot start week of June 21, close evaluation and decision by July 9. Can you share a brief MAP (milestones + owners) and the networking checklist we should hand to our cloud team?

Thanks,
Clara

--
Clara Jensen
Director, Platform Engineering | ClearVista
clara.jensen@clearvista.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@clearvista.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@clearvista.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot collaboration — high level asks and timeline

Hi Clara — great to hear. I've sketched a short MAP below and attached the networking requirements doc for your infra team. I also looped in Ben (solutions) for VPC peering specifics and Monica (CS) for mutual acceptance criteria and eval prompts.

Proposed MAP (owners & dates)
- June 11–14: Paperwork & NDAs (ClearVista legal + Redwood sales) — owner: Clara / Priya
- June 15–18: Org & API key provisioning (Redwood to create test org + scoped API keys) — owner: Priya / Ben
- June 18–21: IP allowlist + VPC peering setup (ClearVista to apply allowlist; Redwood to accept peering) — owner: Tom / Ben
- June 21: Pilot kickoff (sample workload & eval scenarios handed off) — owner: Monica / Clara
- June 21–Jul 2: Evaluation window (quality/latency/cost tracking) — owner: Monica
- Jul 5–9: Close review & decision (review MAP metrics + final contract terms) — owners: Clara / Priya

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm the CIDR blocks you can provide for allowlist and whether you want a single peering connection or per-env peers.
2) Point to a short list of eval prompts/workloads you care about (we'll convert to pass/fail checks).

Attachments: Redwood networking requirements (high level), sample MAP checklist.

If the timeline looks good I'll issue the test org and API keys by EOD Friday (June 11).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0142
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@clearvista.com>, Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@clearvista.com>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot collaboration — high level asks and timeline

Hi Tom / Clara — copying the technical specifics you asked for so your cloud team can start work. I'll be your point for peering and the ephemeral key flow.

Short checklist for ClearVista infra
- Provide production/test CIDR(s) for allowlist: recommended minimal set: 18.205.0.0/16 (example), and any NAT egress ranges.
- VPC peering model: we support (a) single-tenant cross-account peering (preferred) or (b) transit via customer-managed gateway. Please advise which you prefer.
- Required IAM roles: a service account with ability to accept peering connections and add route entries.
- Ephemeral API keys: Redwood will issue scoped keys via the private console; recommend a 12-hour TTL for the trial.

Attachment: redwood-network-requirements-v1.pdf (network diagram + BGP notes).

Sample Peering params:
- Redwood ASN: 64512
- Expected keepalive: 60s
- Suggested MTU: 1500

I'll join Tom's cloud standup next Monday to walk through the steps if that helps.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@clearvista.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@clearvista.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot collaboration — high level asks and timeline

Ben — thanks for the details. Our infra confirms the following:
- We can provide allowlist CIDRs: 10.48.0.0/16 (app subnet) and 3.101.128.0/20 (egress NAT).
- We prefer a single-tenant cross-account peering.
- We'll create a peering accept role and share ARNs by EOD Tuesday Jun 15.

Questions for Redwood:
1) What's the exact process for the ephemeral API key issuance (API or console)?
2) Can we get guidance on any required proxy / egress rules for streaming token traffic?

We attached ClearVista's security questionnaire (partial) with a couple of items we need answers to before we can start.

Tom

--
Tom Lee
Cloud Architect | ClearVista
3.101.128.45 | tom.lee@clearvista.com
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@clearvista.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@clearvista.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot collaboration — high level asks and timeline

Thanks all — quick status and next steps so there's a clear handoff: 

Status:
- NDAs signed (legal done).
- Redwood test org created: clearvista-eval (we've invited Clara and Tom as admins).
- Scoped API keys: ready to issue once Tom confirms peering ARN; we'll issue a 12-hour TTL key on request.
- ClearVista provided CIDRs (10.48.0.0/16 and 3.101.128.0/20) — Ben marked as allowlisted in staging config.

Immediate next steps (owners + due dates):
- Jun 18: ClearVista to share peering accept role ARNs (owner: Tom).
- Jun 18–20: Redwood to accept peering and validate routes (owner: Ben).
- Jun 21: Kickoff call 9am PT — pilot runbook walkthrough and eval scenarios (owner: Monica).
- Jun 21–Jul 2: Evaluation window (Monica to capture metrics & dashboards).
- Jul 5: Close sync (initial results + contract next steps).

DocuSign / Commercial: Priya will follow up with a short-term trial agreement if the pilot metrics look aligned during the window. For now we won't provision production keys until post-eval.

Attachments: updated MAP checklist and the ClearVista partial security questionnaire with inline notes (attached).

See you on the kickoff — added calendar invite.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
